hints.title: Palindrome Concatenation Slices
hints.text: For words u and v to form a palindrome when concatenated as uv, either u or v must contain a palindrome prefix or suffix, while the rest matches the reversal of the other.

hints.title: Index Lookups for Reversed Words
hints.text: Store all words reversed with their indices. For each word, consider splitting it into prefix and suffix at every possible position.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Palindrome Checks
hints.text: If a prefix is palindromic and the reversed suffix exists in the dictionary with a different index, the reversed suffix plus the current word forms a palindrome. Similarly, if the suffix is palindromic and the reversed prefix exists in the dictionary, the current word plus the reversed prefix forms a palindrome.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of words in list
complexity.notes: Iterating over splits and validating substring palindromes takes O(L^2) per word.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of words takes O(N^2 * L) which times out for N = 50000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map of reversed strings allows O(L) candidate lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose strings into prefixes and suffixes and look up complements.
